harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent NFS share from node1:/srv/nfs/shared to node2:/mnt/shared. Both systems use dataops UID/GID 4500, the shared directory is mode 2770, cross-node ownership was verified, and both nodes recovered successfully from sequential reboots.
actions_performed: Installed legacy-compatible NFS packages without changing Ubuntu 7.10 or kernel 2.6.22-14-generic.
Created dataops with UID/GID 4500 on both nodes.
Exported /srv/nfs/shared from node1 to node2 with rw,sync,no_subtree_check.
Added a persistent NFS mount in node2's /etc/fstab.
Verified files created from both nodes retain UID/GID 4500:4500 and group-writable permissions.
Sequentially restarted node1 and node2 and verified changed boot identities and full recovery.

evidence.summary: Both nodes report dataops as uid=4500 and gid=4500 before and after restart.

evidence.requirement: node1 exports /srv/nfs/shared with ownership dataops:dataops and mode 2770
evidence.summary: The active export is restricted to node2, NFSv3 responds, and the directory is 4500:4500 mode 2770.

evidence.requirement: node2 persistently mounts the share at /mnt/shared
evidence.summary: The fstab entry persisted and the NFS mount is active after reboot with mode 2770 and ownership 4500:4500.

evidence.requirement: Files created on either system retain consistent ownership and permissions
evidence.summary: Files created from node1 and node2 are visible from both systems as UID/GID 4500:4500 with mode 660 and matching contents.

evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel were retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on Ubuntu 7.10 with kernel 2.6.22-14-generic.
Baseline boot ID 22f1242e… changed to 170d533f…; NFS RPC services, export, data, client mount, and a fresh client write recovered.
Baseline boot ID 648de97e… changed to fb27b20a…; the persistent mount, identity, existing data, NFS access, and a fresh write recovered.
